newsitem.title: UK: U.S. Treasuries lower on Tankan, await U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries lower on Tankan, await U.S. data.

text.p: Treasuries fell in London on Wednesday after a robust Japanese tankan report sent the dollar skidding and sparked speculation a Japanese interest rate rise may be on the horizon, traders said.
"The bond market is struggling and I see room for further slippage ahead of today's U.S. data," said a trader at a continental European bank in London.

The diffusion index of manufacturing companies in the tankan survey came in at plus seven, the highest since November 1991, and well off consensus forecasts of around zero. Non-manufacturers and smaller firms remained significantly less optimistic however.
The benchmark long bond was quoted at 98-28 at 1031 GMT, for a yield of 6.712, compared with 98-31 in Tokyo and 99-04 at the New York close on Tuesday.
September T-bond futures were down 8/32 at 111-29 in automated trade.
